description: This file defines the ComponentResourceHandler class, which manages resource information for components in the OFBiz framework. It provides methods to load XML documents, get resource streams and URLs, check resource types, and handle resource metadata.

classes.name: ComponentResourceHandler
classes.description: Implements ResourceHandler to manage component resource data including loading XML, retrieving streams and URLs, and resource metadata.

methods.name: ComponentResourceHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing with component name and XML element, extracting loader and location attributes.

methods.name: ComponentResourceHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing with component name, loader name, and location, with optional verbose debug logging.

methods.name: getLoaderName
methods.description: Returns the loader name associated with this resource handler.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Loads and returns the XML Document from the resource stream, handling exceptions.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Provides an InputStream for the resource via ComponentConfig.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Provides the URL of the resource via ComponentConfig.

methods.name: isFileResource
methods.description: Checks if the resource loader is a file resource.

methods.name: getFullLocation
methods.description: Returns the full file path or URL location of the resource.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides equality to compare componentName, loaderName, and location.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Provides a hash code based on componentName, loaderName, and location.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a descriptive string including component name, loader name, and location.
